argv: cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; dpkg-query -W -f='${Package} ${Version} ${db:Status-Status}\n' iio-sensor-proxy libssc2 gts9-hexagonrpc pd-mapper libprotobuf-c1 libqrtr1 2>&1; echo @@fastrpc-account; getent passwd fastrpc; getent group fastrpc; echo @@services; systemctl list-unit-files '*hexagonrpc*' '*pd-mapper*' '*iio-sensor*' --no-pager; echo @@payload-conflicts; for p in /usr/bin/hexagonrpcd /usr/bin/pd-mapper /usr/bin/ssccli /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libssc.so.2 /usr/libexec/iio-sensor-proxy /usr/lib/udev/rules.d/10-fastrpc.rules; do if test -e "$p"; then sha256sum "$p"; dpkg-query -S "$p" 2>&1; fi; done
